name: Voidripper Helmet (Modified)
description: This version of Sakura Sun's Voidripper helmet has been modified from its original form. Embrace your inner beast by equipping the Voidripper helmet. Layers of heavy armor plating provide premium protection and an unforgettable visage featuring a heavy brow and piercing turquoise eyes. Sakura Sun designers complimented this striking form with supreme function, including a state of the art sensor suite attached to the helmet's right side. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.
